generation_history.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Modular FACE facial-hair component for Santi Wong. Image1 approvedSanti defines his compact black curled handlebar moustache and distinctive pointed GOATEE, fuller and longer than Captain's tiny chin tuft. Image2 Captain facial-hair sheet is component arrangement/workflow/style only. Image3 Santi bald head is fit reference, no head in output.
Generate ONLY ONE connected black/darkbrown handlebar moustache at upperlip plus ONE SEPARATE tapered chin goatee below, placed as if on Santi's invisible rounded face. Moustache two small curving lobes join at philtrum, fine upcurled tips across uppercheeks. Goatee an actual pointed tuft on chin, no cheek beard or sideburns. Leave white gap for mouth between moustache and goatee. Keep goatee short enough to match original reference, not a full hanging beard. These two hair islands collectively one face-slot model. No skin, nose, mouth, teeth, eyebrows, haircap or guide head. Broad sculpted cartoon locks and soft highlights, not photoreal hairstrands.
One horizontal row of4 groups FRONT LEFT BACK RIGHT. Front and reverse/back show moustache width; rear is concave skin attachment surfaces, not a duplicate convex front. Profiles correctly curve along invisible cheek: leftview rounded centre atleft and tips sweep backwardsright; rightmirror. Goatee attachment slightly forward belowlowerlip in profiles. All4 preserve same anatomical moustache-to-chin spacing and SAME total height and lowestgoatee baseline. Narrow profiles retain physical width, no magnification. Four clear separated whole groups, large purewhite bands. Pure opaque white background no shadows labels text or extra objects.
